- Any minimum sustained throughput or SLOs we should expect (p50/p95 latency targets)

Can you also call out whether deep discounts require a prepaid/annual commit or if you support monthly tiered pricing with rebates?

Appreciate an example cost run for 500M tokens split ~85% generation / 15% embeddings. Happy to share more telemetry if that helps.

Best,

Hi Miriam — thanks for the clear brief. Short answer and then a couple of clarifying Qs.

High-level hosted rates (list prices, US region):
- Text generation (completion): $0.045 per 1K tokens (list)
- Embeddings: $0.009 per 1K tokens (list)

Suggested volume bands and typical commercial levers we deploy:
- 0–50M: list pricing
- 50M–250M: 10–18% off list (depends on term and token mix)
- 250M–750M: 22–33% off list (requires commitment or rolling rebate)
- 750M+: 34–45% off list (usually requires annual commit or prepaid credit)

Other negotiable items: smoothing/rollover credits (we can offer a limited monthly rollover pool tied to the commit), staged ramp schedule, and a pilot credit for evaluation. Deeper discounts typically require at least a 6–12 month commit; best pricing usually tied to a 12-month prepay or an annual commit with monthly true-ups.

A few clarifying Qs that will materially change banding:
1) Token mix: you mentioned 85% generation / 15% embeddings — can you confirm split by token volume (not requests)?
2) Peak sustained throughput target (tokens/sec) — is this bursty or steady?
3) Do you expect multi-region serving (US + EU) or single-region?

I've attached a short ratecard PDF and a worked example Excel illustrating unit economics at different discounts. Ben and Aditya are on the thread to add technical and commercial detail.

If OK, we can convert this into a formal term sheet (MOU) after we lock the bands and commit term.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Quick technical notes from the infra/SE side — these affect effective cost and throughput:
- Caching: if you can cache common prompts or prefixes (search query templates), you can reduce completion token counts significantly. That may move you down a discount band without increasing spend.
- Model choice: running a smaller, cheaper supervised model for high-volume short responses vs. a large omni-model can reduce per-token costs by ~20–40%. We can show an alternate cost table if you share example prompt length distributions.
- Sustained throughput: for hosted API, our p95 generative latency target for the standard hosted tier is ~220–400ms for typical seq lengths. If you need guaranteed throughput (e.g., 100k tokens/sec sustained), we recommend evaluating Redwood Dedicated or an explicit capacity reservation; hosted can handle bursts but SLAs for sustained extreme throughput are better under Dedicated.

If you want, we can run a short synthetic traffic profile (1–2 days) against a representative prompt set to produce a realistic monthly cost projection.

-Ben

Miriam — following up with an example commercial that maps to a 500M token baseline (assumes 85/15 split generation/embeddings). Numbers below are illustrative; final quote will include exact token weighting and any negotiated credits.

Example (monthly average for 500M tokens):
- List cost (no discount): Generation: 425M tokens * $0.045 /1K = $19,125
  Embeddings: 75M tokens * $0.009 /1K = $675
  Total list = $19,800 / month

Commercial options we typically offer:
A) Monthly tiered (no term): 15% blended discount at 500M — ~$16.8K / month
B) 12-month commit (monthly true-up): 25% blended discount — ~$14.85K / month
C) 12-month prepay (upfront): 30% blended discount + 5% prepay credit — effective ~$12.5K / month equivalent

Smoothing and rollover: for options B and C we can include a 15% monthly rollover pool tied to the commit (unused tokens in a month roll into a pool you can draw down later). Rollover is not transferable between accounts and expires at term end.

Pilot/POC: we can provide $25K in consumption credits for a 30-day pilot (applied before any commit). If you convert to an annual commit within 60 days, we will roll leftover pilot credits into month 1 of the term.

Attached: Hosted_Commit_Illustration.xlsx (worked examples for 250M/500M/1B). If acceptable, I can draft an MOU and a commercial summary for legal review.
